task.title: P6-108: Run the full Scryfall bulk load against Neon dev then prod
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 2 — Ship gates). Original id: P6-108. Size: M. Specs: specs/catalog-ingestion.md.

**Run the full Scryfall bulk load** (stage 2 of catalog-ingestion) against Neon dev, then prod, and verify it. The loader is already written and gate-tested — `Mode::Bulk`, `server --ingest bulk`, the snapshot gate and the unconditional price refresh all ship today (`app/src/ingest/mod.rs`, `server/src/main.rs`); what remains is a supervised run, not an implementation. Today's catalog is the POC subset: **2,976 printings of ~116K** — five set codes (`mh3, tmh3, amh3, m3c, lea`) plus 15 named printings and their closure (`app/src/ingest/poc_filter.json`), so any card outside those sets is absent entirely, not merely a missing variant. **Prereq: `P6-124`.** **Risk this run carries that the POC run did not:** the 2026-07-20 prod POC ran against **zero user rows**; a full load against live `holdings`/`desires` FK'ing `printings` is a different risk class (specs/catalog-ingestion.md:494-498). **Acceptance:** stage-2 criteria at specs/catalog-ingestion.md:288-296 — printing count within tolerance of ~116K, an immediate re-run is a near-no-op (0 cards / 0 printings written), timings recorded in Findings. Split from `P6-105` 2026-07-28; probe evidence in specs/phase-6-probes/P6-105.md.
